mostBought.source: Source: SEC, Form 13F (EDGAR){reports}. Quarterly, with up to a 45-day lag. Each investor is compared with their previous quarter ({n} compared{withoutHistory}{partial}). US long positions only; options do not count. The 13F has no ticker, so the issuer and its CUSIP are shown. Value = current position of those buying, in dollars.
